agreements: The appropriate near-term experiment is a small complementary v6simple recipe assay, not the final persistent-context thinker, what-to-think recursion, intelligent sleeper, lifelong learner, or paper study described by the broader human directive.

The only defensible result is an integrity/completion disposition plus descriptive fixed-panel trajectories and contrasts; one life and four syntactic holdouts cannot establish efficacy, superiority, causal credit, outcome modeling, semantic generalization, functional correctness, population behavior, or a paper claim.

The success-filtered writer contains pre-action context and action targets only; post-action improvement controls row admission but is not an outcome target, reward model, failure contrast, temporal-credit signal, rationale, or private-thought channel.

A bounded canonical packet, strict one-field response grammar, six charged slots, own bounded public memory, frozen target-blind selection, exact mounted-adapter hash, same-snapshot E_ON/E_OFF diagnostic, no retry or tuning, and post-run review are the scientifically useful core.

No factorial controls, multiple lives, semantic-family model, free-flow thinker arm, duplicate adapter build, or paper-scale inference is required to decide whether this exact lower-bracket recipe is runnable, provided the report language remains narrow.

Architecture consensus cannot authorize implementation, sealing, model calls, training, GPU use, target opening, or result release; a repaired exact proposal must repeat the bound deliberation and human-ratification chain.

disagreements.issue: How to obtain a matched pre-sleep history when full H and E events and snapshots cannot be byte-identical because they contain different identities.

positions.position: Run independent H and E acquisition tasks 1--4 and require packets, effective weights, outputs, outcomes, events, memories, and snapshots to match exactly.
Keep independent prefixes but compare an architecture-defined projection that excludes only identity fields while binding both complete artifacts.

Avoid both redundant execution and a parity projection: execute one neutral shared tasks-1--4 prefix once, then clone its exact identity-free state and event references into H and E at the first sleep boundary.

resolution.rationale: A single shared prefix is the simplest valid pre-treatment control. It makes equal history true by construction, removes a guaranteed identity mismatch and duplicate model/environment work, and leaves the intended intervention unchanged: E alone compiles the common successful rows at sleep 1 while H remains on the base model.
resolution.selected_position: Use one common on-policy acquisition prefix for tasks 1--4 and fork it into H and E immediately before E's first sleep; do not compare separately generated identity-bearing H/E prefix artifacts.
resolution.required_change: The successor must define a neutral, identity-free canonical prefix event ledger and snapshot for tasks 1--4 with event_seq 0--23. After the task-4 commit, clone the exact snapshot bytes and shared-ledger references into H and E with next_event_seq 24; actor/condition identity belongs only in an audit/fork envelope and never in model-visible state or the cloned snapshot. E sleep 1 compiles eligible shared-prefix rows, H mounts no adapter, and H/E independently execute tasks 5--8. Remove every task-1--4 parity comparison and identity-bearing system field from the state being asserted equal. T01, T03, T05, and T06 must verify one prefix, exact clone hashes, correct branch mounts, and no duplicate prefix calls.

disagreements.issue: Whether the registered post-run test is reliably invoked before any descriptive result or integrity disposition is released.

positions.position: V6S6_T06_ACTUAL_RUN_CONFORMANCE is required_before scientific_claim.
The differently named V6S_T06_ACTUAL_RUN_CONFORMANCE is required before any result release.
Use the registered V6S6_T06_ACTUAL_RUN_CONFORMANCE identifier everywhere and make it a hard gate before every result or disposition release because scientific claims are forbidden.

resolution.rationale: Exact IDs and authority stages are not interchangeable. A scientific_claim gate is unreachable for an assay that forbids scientific claims and would permit descriptive output to bypass post-run verification.
resolution.selected_position: Use exactly V6S6_T06_ACTUAL_RUN_CONFORMANCE and set its structured authority point to result_release.
resolution.required_change: Replace every V6S_T06 spelling with V6S6_T06_ACTUAL_RUN_CONFORMANCE; set required_before to result_release; quarantine all target values, per-cell scores, aggregate values, and terminal disposition until its independent verdict is committed; and distinguish a validated INTEGRITY_FAILURE report from an unverifiable evidence bundle, for which only a conformance-failure notice may be released. T05 must verify the exact T06 procedure and release transition before the 7B run is presented for human approval.

disagreements.issue: What may be reported when one of the twelve target cells is indeterminate, and how exact F and D values are serialized.

positions.position: Continue other isolated cells after a target failure, finish with INDETERMINATE, and report raw curves, validity, F, D_HE, and D_ONOFF without a separate missing-cell rule.
Freeze one rule before target access; preferably suppress aggregate D values whenever any required cell is missing while preserving raw determinate evidence and an explicit missing-cell map.

resolution.rationale: Complete-case selection after seeing failures would introduce avoidable analysis flexibility. Exact rational representation is simple because every F is a ratio of bounded integers and no decision depends on floating-point magnitude.
resolution.selected_position: If any target cell is missing, report INDETERMINATE, the explicit 3-by-4 validity/missing map, and raw curves plus exact per-cell F only for determinate cells; suppress both aggregate D values entirely.
resolution.required_change: Define missing per-cell F as JSON null and both D_HE and D_ONOFF as JSON null unless all twelve required cells are determinate. Do not compute a complete-case, surviving-condition, imputed, or partial-panel mean. Represent every determinate F and complete-panel D as a reduced exact rational with signed numerator, positive denominator, and canonical zero; optional decimal rendering is display-only and non-authoritative. T01 must golden the arithmetic and suppression table, while T05/T06 must enforce it before release.

disagreements.issue: Whether every runtime receipt schema and hash link must be expanded into architecture bytes, or whether the architecture can bind core semantics and freeze exact implementation schemas at pre-GPU review.

positions.position: The protocol already closes exact execution and T01--T06 can reconstruct every packet, event, receipt, process, and report.
Add versioned additionalProperties-false schemas, byte examples, domains, identities, pre/post hashes, and failure variants for every artifact in the finite run DAG before architecture ratification.

Core causal and provenance interfaces need exact semantics, but canonicalizing every log, temporary file, process fact, and peripheral receipt at architecture time turns implementation detail into an unnecessarily large research design.

resolution.rationale: The treatment, state transitions, target accounting, and release decision must be architecture-defined, while exact field ordering for ordinary implementation receipts can be authored and tested in B1 and then frozen by T05 plus the later human run-manifest ratification. This preserves auditability without another protocol-scale schema expansion.
resolution.selected_position: Keep architecture bytes exact about semantic invariants and mandatory provenance, but freeze versioned implementation receipt schemas, examples, and hashes as part of the exact pre-GPU review bundle rather than expanding them all into the successor protocol.
resolution.required_change: The successor protocol must define the semantics and required provenance for shared-prefix and branch snapshots, memory observation source, pre/post snapshot links, task/sleep commit order, target and failed-cell identity, canonical sealer comparison/promotion, selected rows, mounted adapter hash, process completion, quarantine barrier, conformance verdict, and final report. B1 may choose compact versioned schemas for those records and supporting telemetry. T01--T04 validate them; T05 freezes every schema/source/example hash and producer/consumer mapping in the exact 7B run bundle; Rohin ratifies those exact bytes; no schema drift is allowed afterward; T06 recomputes only the frozen core evidence needed for the registered disposition and report. Do not require architecture schemas for every log line, temporary artifact, or incidental runtime fact.

disagreements.issue: What isolation claim and enforcement level are necessary for this narrow assay.

positions.position: Eleven logical actors obey default-deny read/create/write/delete rights, and exact repository, library, environment, driver, command, path, network, service, cache, process, and teardown surfaces support a finite noninterference finding.
Strengthen the proposal with a concrete per-actor OS sandbox, escape-resistant capability policy, tamper-evident enforcement receipts, and separate publisher/loader privileges.

The necessary scientific property is much smaller: frozen application dataflow must prevent target results, condition labels, other-branch state, and unauthorized training rows from influencing model decisions or the mounted treatment. A global or exhaustive OS-level noninterference claim is neither supported nor proportionate.

resolution.rationale: The stronger OS proposal would turn a minimal learning assay into a secure-systems experiment while still proving only enumerated negatives. The current allowlist is also internally inconsistent because it withholds report/manifest writes and combines publication/loading. A smaller explicit dataflow contract is both testable and sufficient for the narrow claim.
resolution.selected_position: Make no OS-level, global, or exhaustive noninterference claim. Enforce and audit only the causal application boundaries needed to keep target results and branch/treatment state out of unauthorized model, trainer, and future-decision inputs.
resolution.required_change: Replace the eleven-principal default-deny OS contract with a compact component/dataflow contract covering: frozen sealer outputs; shared-prefix and branch state; model request projection; E-only selected rows; single adapter publication and exact-hash loading; target-local fork inputs; append-only result collection; and reporter activation after all target calls finish. The controller may know the frozen target manifest, but target role and future identities must not enter model packets and no target result may enter any later model/trainer/life choice. Separate mutation from read-only mount in code or mode, explicitly authorize manifest and report creation, and test forbidden application edges and quarantine timing in T03/T06. Pin dependency/model/runtime bytes for reproducibility at T05, but remove requirements to prove denial of every OS read, inherited descriptor, shared library, environment variable, metadata path, cache, IPC, network fact, or wall-clock source. Reports may claim only conformance of the frozen application dataflow on recorded surfaces.

disagreements.issue: Whether duplicate builds and numerical tolerance are necessary to call the writer deterministic in this first-life assay.

positions.position: Sleep 1 is built once, final build A is authentic, and comparison-only build B must agree with A within two numerical tolerances before targets.
Either call the property bounded reproducibility or add comparison builds, including sleep 1 if execution determinism is claimed.

Do not add a sleep-1 duplicate and do not keep final build B merely to defend a determinism label; execute the frozen recipe once per sleep, bind each realized adapter hash, and make no exact or numerical reproducibility claim.

resolution.rationale: Duplicate training does not improve the causal contrast and materially increases cost. This assay asks whether one pinned recipe completes, not whether GPU optimization is reproducible. Exact realized artifact identity is sufficient for mounting and audit.
resolution.selected_position: Remove build B and all duplicate-training, tensor-tolerance, deterministic-writer, and rebuild-reproducibility requirements; retain one realized sleep-1 build and one realized cumulative sleep-2 build with exact manifests and hashes.
resolution.required_change: Rename the path a frozen success-filtered writer or single-run compilation recipe. Each sleep starts from the pinned clean base with the registered rows/order/optimizer and produces one adapter. Require exact row/copy/update counts, target-only masks, finite losses/gradients/tensors, complete trainable-tensor inventory, atomic publication, teardown, and a content hash for the realized adapter and manifest. Mount only the exact sleep-2 hash. T02 tests the algorithm and failure behavior synthetically; T05 binds the implementation/seed/runtime; T06 verifies the actual single builds. Do not infer determinism or bounded reproducibility from completion.

disagreements.issue: Whether to authorize an indivisible 32B GH200 first run under a detailed resource estimate or begin with a smaller feasibility canary.

positions.position: After T05 and human ratification, run the entire fixed recipe once with a 32B model on one GH200, without a preliminary learned canary or rerun.
Keep 32B but require a quantitative worst-case activation, optimizer, storage, deterministic-kernel, and wall-clock envelope before authorization.

Make the first and only learned assay under this change a 7B GH200 feasibility canary, with modest static resource checks; any later 32B run is a separate registered change rather than an automatic promotion.

resolution.rationale: A 7B run is better aligned with the owner's request to get a simple lower bracket turning and with the noninferential claim boundary. It reduces the need for speculative wall-clock modeling and the cost of discovering ordinary integration failures. Calling it a canary preserves that its result is recipe feasibility, not efficacy.
resolution.selected_position: Replace the 32B indivisible run with one exact 7B GH200 end-to-end feasibility canary; do not authorize or imply automatic 32B continuation.
resolution.required_change: The successor and T05 must bind one exact 7B model/tokenizer/runtime/LoRA recipe, the same frozen acquisition/target selection rules, one shared prefix, two single realized sleeps, and twelve target cells. Before human run ratification, check static model/LoRA/optimizer/activation and scratch-storage fit, supported kernels, available disk, an operator-reviewed time estimate, and an explicit timeout; no guaranteed wall-clock proof is required. The 7B canary's target results remain quarantined until T06 and cannot tune or repair that run. A later 32B run, target reuse or replacement, recipe change, or claim expansion requires a new architecture change and fresh human authorization.

disagreements.issue: What exact source/bitcode distinctness T04 must enforce for the selected 8/4 panel.

positions.position: The 8/4 source and bitcode hashes are distinct.
All twelve selected source hashes must be pairwise distinct and, separately, all twelve selected bitcode hashes must be pairwise distinct; cross-modality equality is not a scientific requirement.
The proposal should also decide whether any source hash may equal any bitcode hash.

resolution.rationale: Nonreuse within each modality is the selection invariant implied by the protocol and relevant to syntactic holdout. Comparing hashes of different representations adds no meaningful scientific separation.
resolution.selected_position: Require twelve pairwise-distinct source hashes and twelve pairwise-distinct bitcode hashes across acquisition plus targets; impose no cross-modality comparison.
resolution.required_change: State the selected-panel rule verbatim in change.json, protocol.md, T04, the sealer receipt, and the final limitation report. Keep the deterministic first-eight/next-four selection and double-seal check. Explicitly state that even exact within-modality nonreuse establishes only syntactic byte holdout, not semantic independence, distribution shift, or population generalization.

disagreements.issue: Whether completion of this fixed recipe can stand for completion or validation of the broader Experience Model v6 context and sleeper architecture.

positions.position: The title uses Experience Model v6, while the body repeatedly describes a separately namespaced lower bracket with narrow claims.
Retain the assay only under explicit human acceptance that it is complementary and cannot validate persistent context, deciding what to think, time awareness, or intelligent memory compilation.

resolution.rationale: The proposal's substantive claim boundary is already correct, but naming and later summaries can still collapse lower-bracket completion into thesis validation. Explicit scope ratification prevents that without adding arms or cognitive machinery.
resolution.selected_position: Keep the assay in a separate v6simple feasibility namespace and require explicit owner acceptance that the broader thinker/sleeper/context design remains open.
resolution.required_change: Every proposal, review, run manifest, T06 verdict, and report must label the run a 7B v6simple success-filtered action-cloning feasibility canary. RECIPE_COMPLETE means only that those exact bytes completed. Preserve prohibitions on general improvement, outcome learning, causal mechanism, efficacy, superiority, functional correctness, semantic generalization, lifelong learning, saturation, population, and paper claims. Persistent context/KV reuse, context curation, conscious/subconscious what-to-think loops, time awareness, intelligent sleep, replication, and stronger controls require separate changes.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Independent identity-bearing prefix artifacts cannot be byte-identical; the simpler repair is one shared neutral prefix rather than an exclusion projection.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Run tasks 1--4 once, clone one identity-free prefix state into H/E, and remove all identity-bearing parity requirements and duplicate prefix execution.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The unregistered spelling and scientific_claim authority point can bypass the intended post-run gate.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use only V6S6_T06_ACTUAL_RUN_CONFORMANCE and make it mandatory before release of any value or disposition.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Without a predeclared missing-cell rule, aggregate selection can occur after outcomes are known.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Preserve raw determinate cells and a missing map, set missing F and both aggregate D values to null when any cell is missing, and use canonical exact rationals otherwise.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Core state, mount, target-cell, barrier, and report semantics need closure, but exact schemas for every peripheral artifact need not become architecture bytes.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Define core semantics/provenance in the successor, implement compact schemas in B1, and freeze their exact bytes and hashes at T05 plus the later human 7B run ratification.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The current allowlist cannot create its own closed manifest/report and conflates target identity, target result influence, publication, and mounting.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Replace it with the compact application dataflow contract in D05, explicitly authorizing necessary outputs and protecting model/trainer/future choices from target results.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Exhaustive OS negative claims and per-log byte closure are disproportionate to the assay and can dominate the learning recipe without yielding global noninterference evidence.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Remove OS-level noninterference and exhaustive capability proof; test and review only the frozen causal application boundaries and core receipt surfaces.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The recipe can bind realized artifacts without defending an exact or tolerance-based training determinism claim through duplicate work.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Remove build B and all duplicate/determinism language; create and hash one adapter per sleep under the frozen recipe.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A 32B first run is unnecessarily risky for a lower-bracket constructibility test; modest resource checks around a 7B canary are more proportionate than speculative exhaustive estimation.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Make the only learned run a separately ratified 7B GH200 feasibility canary with static fit, storage, kernel, timeout, and reviewed time checks; require a new change for 32B.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The exact eligibility invariant is pairwise uniqueness over all twelve within each representation, not an unspecified 8/4 or cross-representation rule.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Require all twelve source hashes pairwise distinct and all twelve bitcode hashes pairwise distinct, with no cross-modality check and no semantic-holdout claim.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The assay is valuable only if completion cannot be promoted into validation of the broader v6 cognitive architecture.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind the 7B v6simple feasibility label and deferred thinker/sleeper/context questions in human approval, review, and every report.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: The contradiction is real, but a shared neutral prefix is simpler and stronger than executing twice and comparing an identity-excluding projection.
Resource fit needs review, but the better lower-bracket remedy is a 7B canary with modest static checks rather than an elaborate 32B worst-case forecast.
Any incomplete panel must suppress both aggregate contrasts under one frozen rule while preserving raw determinate cells and the missing map.
The post-run gate must use the one registered V6S6 identifier everywhere.
Identity-bearing equality is impossible, but shared-prefix cloning removes the need for a parity projection or duplicate calls.
Core semantic evidence must be closed, but schema-expanding every runtime artifact in architecture bytes is unnecessary; exact implementation schemas are frozen at T05 and human run ratification.
The present actor contract is inconsistent and needs actual application-boundary evidence, but an exhaustive per-actor OS sandbox and noninterference claim is rejected as disproportionate.
The determinism label is unsupported; instead of adding comparison builds or retaining bounded-reproducibility language, remove the claim and bind the single realized builds.
T06 must be a hard result-release gate, not a never-reached scientific-claim gate.
The assay remains valuable only as a separately labeled complementary lower bracket with the broader directive explicitly deferred.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retain the bounded packet/state/score golden layer, but the successor must replace independent prefix parity with one neutral prefix and exact clone transitions, add missing-cell suppression and rational encodings, and test the core implementation schemas frozen for T05.

Retain writer selection, packet/target binding, masks, optimizer, counts, atomic failure, inventory, and exact mount-hash goldens; remove build-A/B comparison math, duplicate-training evidence, and every determinism or reproducibility assertion.

Retain as an application-level dataflow and lifecycle test for prefix cloning, branch isolation, exact mounts/snapshots, forbidden target-result edges, no writeback, and quarantine timing. Remove exhaustive OS/principal capability denial and global noninterference implications.

Retain exactly two unchanged-local CPU no-model seals, with one frozen comparison/promotion path and an explicit requirement that all twelve source hashes are pairwise distinct and all twelve bitcode hashes are pairwise distinct. No cross-modality or semantic-independence test is added.

Retain as the pre-GPU freeze point, but review an exact 7B canary bundle, the compact application dataflow, all B1-authored receipt schemas/hashes, modest resource-fit checks, revised single-build writer, T06 result-release transition, and narrow claim language. It authorizes nothing without later human ratification.

Retain this exact registered ID and make it required before result_release. It recomputes the frozen core 7B evidence, single builds, target cells, suppression/rational metrics, barrier, and disposition; it does not attempt OS-level noninterference or duplicate-build determinism verification.
